name: Memucan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Memucan answered before the king and the princes that Vashti had not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes and all the people in all the provinces of the king.

note.label: Esther 1: Vashti Refuses the King and the Law of Order in the House
